title: ErlDP: support features of Erlang/OTP 23
description: As of OTP 23, a new handshake format is in use and a big node creation tags (32 instead of 16 bits) are mandatory. This patch series adds support for these features as well as support for new control messages and UTF-8 encoded atoms (which were introduced in OTP 21/16).

notes.body: Seems like it requires a rebase.
